name: Find timestamped quotes with Arcmira
tagline: Find a quote in indexed YouTube and podcast transcripts, then open the recording at the matching timestamp.
description: Search for a phrase or topic, check the surrounding transcript lines and return a quote with its source link. Use the timestamps to review a clip before editing. Requires the [Arcmira MCP connection](https://arcmira.com/docs/mcp-server) and an Arcmira account. [API documentation](https://arcmira.com/docs).
